name: X All The Y
look: A crude drawing of a figure with a round white head, a blond tuft of hair and a huge open mouth yells while thrusting one fist in the air and holding a broom in the other hand. A spiky yellow burst sits behind the pink-shirted figure on a white background.
use: Shouts an overenthusiastic plan to do something to everything. The caption follows the pattern "[Verb] all the [things]!" split between top and bottom, mocking over-ambitious or obsessive behavior.
slots: bottom caption: 'all the' plus the things
describe: stick figure yelling with fist in the air and a broom
crude drawing of a girl in a pink shirt shouting excitedly
cartoon person screaming with arm raised on a yellow burst

origin: Drawn by Allie Brosh for the 2010 Hyperbole and a Half blog post This Is Why I'll Never Be an Adult.
